ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Kingsville, VIC**, there are several locksmiths that install and configure digital and keyless locks for homes and businesses.

Some well-reviewed options nearby include:

- Precision Locksmiths Melbourne (Spotswood) – Installs and services digital and smart locks, with 24/7 availability.
- Lock, Smith and Barrel (West Footscray) – Offers smart lock installation, lock upgrades, and emergency locksmith services.
- Aus Lock & Safe Company (Sunshine West) – Provides digital door lock installation, access control, and residential/commercial security solutions.
- Hallenstein Locksmith Melbourne (Footscray) – Local locksmith experienced with electronic and smart locking systems.

Many locksmiths servicing Kingsville can install popular brands such as Yale, Lockly, Aqara, Samsung, and Schlage, depending on your door type. They can also:
- Replace an existing deadbolt with a smart lock.
- Install a new smart deadlock on timber or metal doors.
- Set up the mobile app, PIN codes, fingerprints, or key cards.
- Check door alignment to ensure reliable operation.

Installation typically costs around **A$150–A$300** if you already have the lock, though the price can be higher if modifications to the door or strike plate are needed. [globallocksmiths.com.au](https://globallocksmiths.com.au/kingsville/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't purchased a lock yet, tell me:
- your **door type** (timber, aluminium, or security screen), and
- whether you want **keypad**, **fingerprint**, **Apple Home/Google Home**, or **Wi-Fi remote access**,

and I can recommend a compatible smart lock and installer.
